title: Platform Updates | Qubrid Documentation
markdown:
Hostname update:The Qubrid platform is now at qubrid.com. [Read the migration guide](https://docs.platform.qubrid.com/inferencing/Migration)

## [September, 2026](https://docs.platform.qubrid.com/Platform%20Updates\#september-2026)

**Platform hostname**

The Qubrid platform now lives at `https://qubrid.com` instead of `https://platform.qubrid.com`. That includes the dashboard, playground, API keys, inference logs, and the inference API (`/api` and `/v1`). Documentation remains at `https://docs.platform.qubrid.com`. Existing API keys, model IDs, and request paths are unchanged. The previous host continues to work during the transition. See the [Platform Hostname Migration](https://docs.platform.qubrid.com/inferencing/Migration) guide to update bookmarks and integrations.

## [June, 2026](https://docs.platform.qubrid.com/Platform%20Updates\#june-2026)

**Model Comparison**

Model Comparison lets users evaluate Qubrid serverless models side by side before choosing one for production. With Model Comparison, users can:

- Compare models with each other in a single view
- Select a minimum of 2 models and a maximum of 4 models per comparison
- Review streaming responses, latency, and token metrics across selected models
- Run the same prompt against multiple models to judge quality and performance
- Make faster model selection decisions using direct head-to-head results

## [March, 2025](https://docs.platform.qubrid.com/Platform%20Updates\#march-2025)

**API Cost Estimator**

API Cost Estimator helps users forecast and plan their model usage expenses before deploying or adding credits. With the cost estimator, users can:

- Select any model to simulate expected usage costs
- Input estimated daily input and output token usage
- View real-time cost projections for daily and monthly usage
- Understand base pricing for selected models (input/output token rates)
- Get smart recommendations for credit top-ups based on usage patterns
- Make informed decisions on model selection and scaling before deployment

## [December, 2025](https://docs.platform.qubrid.com/Platform%20Updates\#december-2025)

**New Dashboard**

Dashboard is a centralized control panel designed to give users a complete overview of their AI usage, resources, and platform activity in one place. With the new Dashboard, users can:

- Monitor available credits and usage at a glance
- Discover and access trending or latest models from the Models Hub
- Track key metrics such as total tokens, active VMs, and deployments
- Perform quick actions like accessing templates or opening the model catalog
- Manage API keys and interact with Serverless APIs بسهولة
- Explore GPU resources and available configurations
- View recent activity including model usage, inference, and deployments
- Access live demos, documentation, and support directly from the dashboard

## [November, 2025](https://docs.platform.qubrid.com/Platform%20Updates\#november-2025)

**Serverless Model Catalog**

The serverless model catalog makes it easy to discover and call hosted models without managing GPUs. With the catalog, users can:

- Browse available chat and code models in one place
- Compare pricing and model IDs before calling the API
- Authenticate with a Qubrid API key
- Use the OpenAI-compatible `/v1` endpoints from their own apps and tools
- Scale usage with pay-per-token billing
- Move from model selection to production inference quickly

## [October, 2025](https://docs.platform.qubrid.com/Platform%20Updates\#october-2025)

**Model Playground**

Playground is a unified interface that allows users to test and experiment with all models and APIs from a single page. With Playground, users can:

- Evaluate model performance using custom prompts
- View key metrics such as TTFT, TPS, and total tokens
- Adjust model parameters to fine-tune outputs
- Generate API keys and copy API requests directly
- Configure system prompts and include few-shot examples
- Enable or disable streaming directly from the UI
